records.title: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan) official company profile
records.note: Official profile identifies the legal name 東京中小企業投資育成株式会社 and English name Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan), corporate number 9011001030621, established November 15 1963, capital ¥6,673.4 million, 96 employees, and shareholders including local governments (18 prefectures), chambers of commerce, financial institutions and operating companies. It lists Nagoya and Osaka sister companies. This is a distinct regional SME investment-development company, not SBI Holdings or SBI Ripple Asia.

records.title: SBIC East Japan March 5, 2026 seminar: Generative AI (ChatGPT), present and future
records.note: Official event page says Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co. organized a Hamamatsu seminar, co-hosted by Hamamatsu Iwata Shinkin, titled 'The Present and Future of Generative AI (ChatGPT)'. It included a Microsoft Japan speaker and a ChatGPT-use demonstration. The page documents an educational seminar, not an OpenAI commercial partnership, SBI Holdings relationship or XRP investment.

records.title: SBIC East Japan September 2026 investment execution results, published October 15, 2026
records.note: Official release reports that in September 2026 Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation executed five new investments and five reinvestments totaling ¥213.87 million. The public page and attached PDF describe conventional Japanese SME equity investments, including engineering, real estate, steel and precision mold/manufacturing businesses. The announcement is not evidence of XRP, Ripple, SBI Holdings or OpenAI investment.
